description: In front of the hands on the bed are a clear plastic tray with several white cubes inside and a small yellow cup to the right. The left hand stays near the tray rim to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches to the yellow cup as a right-hand object, lifts it, tilts it over the tray to scoop the cubes into the cup, then lifts the cup away and sets it back down to the right.
